📄 Complete Details & Notification

Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has published the provisional result of the competitive examination for Land Surveyor (Bhoomapakaru) posts in the Residual Parent Cadre (RPC) on 09 October 2026. The exam was held on 02 October 2026. Candidates who wish to raise objections to the provisional result must submit them with supporting documents through the KEA link before 11:00 AM on 11 October 2026.

KEA Land Surveyor Provisional Result 2026 Overview

Particulars Details
Conducting Body Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)
Post Name Land Surveyor (Bhoomapakaru)
Cadre Residual Parent Cadre (RPC)
Notice Reference No. ED/KEA/18/Ne.Vi/2026 (RPC)
Notice Date 09.10.2026
Exam Date 02.10.2026
Revised Key Answers Published On 09.10.2026
Provisional Result Published On 09.10.2026
Result Based On Marks scored by candidates as per the revised key answers
Last Date to Raise Objections to Provisional Result 11.10.2026, before 11:00 AM
Mode of Objection Through the link https://cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/, with supporting documents
Number of Vacancies Not mentioned in this notice

KEA Land Surveyor Result 2026 Important Dates

Event Date
Competitive examination for Land Surveyor posts 02.10.2026
Key answers published on the KEA website 03.10.2026
Last date to submit objections to key answers 05.10.2026
Revised key answers published (after subject expert committee review) 09.10.2026
Provisional result published 09.10.2026
Last date to submit objections to the provisional result 11.10.2026, before 11:00 AM

From Key Answers to Provisional Result: What KEA Has Done So Far

  1. KEA conducted the competitive examination for Land Surveyor posts on 02.10.2026.
  2. Key answers were published on the KEA website on 03.10.2026, and candidates could submit objections to them until 05.10.2026.
  3. The objections received were reviewed through a subject expert committee.
  4. Revised key answers were published on 09.10.2026 for candidates' information.
  5. Based on the revised key answers, the provisional result showing the marks scored by candidates was published on 09.10.2026.

How to Raise Objections to the KEA Land Surveyor Provisional Result

The notice says objections to the provisional result must be submitted through the official link along with supporting documents. The steps stated in the notice are:

  1. Open the link given in the notice: https://cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/
  2. Submit your objection to the provisional result together with the supporting documents.
  3. Complete the submission before 11:00 AM on 11.10.2026.

The notice does not describe the login process, the format of the objection or the file size and type for uploads. Candidates should follow the instructions shown on the link itself.

Documents Required for Objections

The notice states that objections must be accompanied by supporting documents. It does not list which documents are acceptable. Keep the documents that support your objection ready before you open the link.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Objections to the provisional result must reach KEA through the link before 11:00 AM on 11.10.2026.
  • Objections without supporting documents will not be considered at this stage.
  • Objections to key answers will not be considered at this stage. The window for key answer objections closed on 05.10.2026.
  • The result is provisional. The notice does not state when a final result will be published.

KEA Land Surveyor Result 2026 Important Links

Purpose Link
Submit objections to the Provisional Result Notice PDF Click Here
KEA official website (as printed on the notice letterhead) http://kea.kar.nic.in

📄 Complete Details & Notification

The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has declared the NDA 2 Result 2026 on 9 October 2026. Candidates whose roll numbers appear in the official PDF have qualified in the written part of the National Defence Academy and Naval Academy Examination (II), 2026 and move on to the Services Selection Board (SSB) interview. The qualification is for admission to the Army, Navy and Air Force Wings of the National Defence Academy (158th Course) and the 120th Indian Naval Academy Course (INAC), both commencing on 1 July 2027.

UPSC NDA 2 Result 2026: Quick Answer

  • Result status: Declared on 9 October 2026 (press note dated 09/10/2026).
  • Where to check: The roll number list PDF on the UPSC website, upsc.gov.in.
  • What is published: Roll numbers of qualified candidates, listed separately for male and female candidates. Names, marks and ranks are not given.
  • Candidature: Provisional for all candidates listed.
  • Next stage: SSB interview. Qualified candidates must register on joinindianarmy.nic.in within two weeks of the result announcement, unless they have already registered.
  • Marks and cut-off: To be uploaded only after the final result of the entire process is declared.

UPSC NDA 2 Result 2026 Overview

Particulars Details
Conducting Body Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)
Exam Name National Defence Academy and Naval Academy Examination (II), 2026
Exam Notice No. 10/2026-NDA-II (as given by reference sources; not stated in the result press note)
Written Exam Date 13 September 2026
Result Date 9 October 2026
Type of Result Written result: roll number list of candidates qualified for SSB interview (provisional)
Admission For Army, Navy and Air Force Wings of NDA (158th Course) and 120th Indian Naval Academy Course (INAC)
Course Commencement 1 July 2027
Next Stage Interview by the Services Selection Board (SSB), Ministry of Defence
Official Website upsc.gov.in
SSB Registration Website joinindianarmy.nic.in

NDA 2 Result 2026 Important Dates

Event Date
Online application window (as per reference sources) 20 May 2026 to 11 June 2026
Written exam 13 September 2026
Provisional answer keys (as per one reference source) 16 September 2026
Written result declared 9 October 2026
Online registration for SSB Within two weeks of the result announcement (no calendar date is printed in the press note)
SSB centre and interview dates To be communicated on the registered e-mail ID
Marks and cut-off marks To be uploaded after the declaration of the final result, and kept online for 30 days
Course commencement 1 July 2027

The press note is dated 9 October 2026. Counting two weeks from that date gives 23 October 2026, but this is a calculation and not a date printed by UPSC. Check the registration portal for the exact deadline.

How to Check NDA 2 Result 2026

You can check the NDA 2 result by searching for your roll number in the official PDF. No login is needed for this list.

  1. Open the UPSC website, upsc.gov.in, and find the written result press note for the National Defence Academy and Naval Academy Examination (II), 2026.
  2. Open the roll number list PDF.
  3. Go to the section for male candidates or female candidates, as applicable.
  4. Press Ctrl + F (Cmd + F on Mac) and type your 7-digit roll number.
  5. If your roll number is found, you are provisionally qualified for the SSB interview. Save or print the page for your records.

What Is in the NDA 2 Result PDF?

  • A press note with the result declaration, registration instructions and contact details.
  • Roll numbers of qualified candidates, listed in roll number order under separate headings for male and female candidates.
  • No candidate names, no marks and no rank order.

This means the PDF works as a qualified roll number list, not a rank-wise merit list.

What to Do After NDA 2 Result 2026

  1. Register online: Register yourself on the Indian Army Recruiting website, joinindianarmy.nic.in, within two weeks of the result announcement. Candidates who have already registered on the site earlier do not need to register again.
  2. Wait for SSB allotment: Selection Centres and SSB interview dates will be allotted after registration and communicated on your registered e-mail ID.
  3. Prepare original certificates: Submit original certificates of Age and Educational Qualification to the respective Services Selection Board during the SSB interview.
  4. Do not send originals to UPSC: Candidates must not send original certificates to the Commission.

Documents Required for SSB Interview

The press note names these documents:

  • Original certificate of Age
  • Original certificate of Educational Qualification

The press note does not list any other documents. Follow the instructions in your SSB communication for the complete checklist.

Important Instructions for Qualified Candidates

  • The candidature of all candidates whose roll numbers are shown in the list is provisional.
  • Registration on joinindianarmy.nic.in is required within two weeks of the result announcement, unless already done.
  • For any query or login problem on the registration site, e-mail [email protected].
  • Original certificates of Age and Educational Qualification go to the SSB, not to UPSC.
  • The result is also available on the Commission's website, upsc.gov.in.

NDA 2 2026 Exam Pattern

The written exam carried 900 marks across two papers, as per reference sources.

Paper Questions Marks
Mathematics 120 300
General Ability Test (English 200 marks, General Knowledge 400 marks) 150 600
Total 270 900

The negative marking scheme is not covered in the result press note. Refer to the official exam notice for it.

NDA 2 Selection Process

  1. Written examination: Held on 13 September 2026. Result declared on 9 October 2026.
  2. SSB interview: Conducted by the Services Selection Board of the Ministry of Defence for candidates who qualified in the written part. Reference sources describe it as a five-day assessment, but the press note does not state its duration.
  3. Medical examination: Listed as the final stage by reference sources. The press note does not describe it.

NDA 2 Cut Off Marks 2026 and Scorecard

The cut-off marks and candidate marks are not available yet. UPSC has said that marks and cut-off marks for this examination will be uploaded on upsc.gov.in only after the entire process is over, that is, after the final result is declared. They will stay on the website for 30 days.

Why Next Week Is Expected: Comparison With Earlier GDS Cycles

Earlier GDS cycles released the first merit list about 18 days after the application last date. The expected date for this cycle is based on that pattern. It is not an official announcement.

Cycle Application Last Date First Merit List Date
Schedule-I, January 2025 cycle 03/03/2025 21/03/2025
Schedule-I, February 2026 cycle 16/02/2026 06/03/2026
Schedule-II, July 2026 cycle 21/09/2026 Excepted to be Released Next Week

Also Read: RRB Section Controller Admit Card 2026

How Is the India Post GDS Merit List Prepared?

There is no written exam for GDS selection. The merit list is system-generated from the marks obtained in the Class 10 examination. Candidates whose names appear in the list are then called for document verification.

The rules for tie-breaking and category-wise selection are in the official notification. They are not covered in the sources used for this article, so please check the notification PDF.

How to Check India Post GDS Result 2026 (1st Merit List)

  1. Visit the official GDS portal: indiapostgdsonline.gov.in.
  2. Open the latest news or shortlisted candidates section, and select the GDS Schedule-II July 2026 cycle.
  3. Click the First Merit List PDF link for your postal circle.
  4. When the PDF opens, press Ctrl+F and search by your name or registration number.
  5. Check your details and the post listed against your name.
  6. Download the PDF and save it for later use.

Details Likely to Be Mentioned in the GDS Merit List PDF

The official format will be known only after release. Based on earlier lists, these details are generally expected:

  • Registration number and candidate name
  • Category and community
  • Date of birth and gender
  • Post applied for
  • Marks or percentage obtained
  • Division and postal circle
  • Selection status

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Rely only on the official portal for the result and for verification instructions.
  • Do not treat an expected date as an official date.
  • Check the PDF of your own postal circle, not another circle.
  • Do not pay anyone or share personal details for "guaranteed selection" offers.
  • Download and keep a copy of the PDF where your name appears.

PFRDA Grade A Phase 1 Exam Pattern 2026

Phase 1 is an online objective test with two papers. Paper 1 is common to all streams. Paper 2 tests stream-specific subjects. Together the two papers carry 200 marks.

Paper 1 (All Streams)

Section Questions Marks

Stream Questions Marks Duration

Research 50 100 40 minutes
Actuary 50 100 40 minutes
Official Language (Rajbhasha) 50 100 40 minutes

Paper 1 is 60 minutes long, so the total test time is 100 minutes. Expect to spend about 160 minutes at the venue, which includes login, call letter collection and reading instructions.

Marking Scheme and Language

  • All questions are multiple choice with five options and one correct answer.
  • For every wrong answer, one-fourth of the marks assigned to that question is deducted.
  • All papers except the English Language section are bilingual, in Hindi and English. Rajbhasha Paper 2 questions are in Hindi and/or English.
  • An answer counts for evaluation only if you click "Save & Next" or "Mark for Review & Next".

  • Printed Phase 1 call letter with a recent passport-size photograph pasted on it (preferably the same photo uploaded during registration)
  • Original, currently valid photo identity proof
  • One photocopy of the same photo ID
  • A ball-point pen and an ink stamp pad

Accepted Photo ID Proofs

The handout lists these as valid:

  • PAN Card
  • Passport
  • Permanent Driving Licence
  • Voter's Card with photograph
  • Bank Passbook with photograph
  • Aadhaar Card or e-Aadhaar with photograph
  • Valid recent ID card issued by a recognised college or university
  • Employee ID (original)
  • Bar Council ID card with photograph
  • Photo ID proof issued on official letterhead by a Gazetted Officer or a People's Representative, with photograph

A Ration Card and a Learner's Driving Licence are not accepted as ID proof.

Name Mismatch Rule

The name on your call letter must exactly match the name on your photo ID. A mismatch can lead to being refused entry. Candidates who have changed their name, including after marriage, are allowed only if they produce a Gazette notification, a marriage certificate or an affidavit.

PFRDA Grade A Exam-Day Instructions

  • Note the date, reporting time and venue address printed on your call letter. Late comers are not allowed.
  • You may visit the exam venue a day before to confirm its location.
  • Calculators, books, notebooks, written notes, mobile phones and other electronic devices are not allowed.
  • Follow the instructions of the Test Administrator and the PFRDA representative at all times.
  • Ask doubts to the Test Administrator only before the exam starts. No queries are answered after it begins.
  • Do not press any keyboard key once the exam starts, as this can lock the exam.
  • You cannot click "Final Submit" until the full test time is used. Answers are saved automatically when the time ends.
  • You will get one sheet of paper for rough work. After the exam, drop this sheet, your call letter and the ID photocopy (stapled together with the call letter) in the designated drop box.
  • Unfair means can lead to disqualification and debarment. Candidates are advised to note the Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024.
  • In case of a technical or administrative problem, PFRDA will try to resolve it. A re-exam is at the exam body's discretion, and candidates cannot claim one.

What to Do If the PFRDA Grade A Admit Card Has an Error or Does Not Download

  1. Recheck your registration number or roll number and your password or date of birth.
  2. Try again after some time, or use a different browser or device.
  3. If your name, photo, signature, category, post or centre details look wrong, contact PFRDA before the exam date.
  4. Use the contact details given in the official recruitment notification or on the call letter. A helpdesk number or email is not listed in the sources used for this article.

SKAU Clerk Typing Test Details

The Clerk typing test is a computer-based test in English. It is the first phase of the Clerk selection process. The official typing test guide gives the following details.

Feature Details
Test Mode Computer based
Language and Font English, Times New Roman
Test Duration 10 minutes
Minimum Typing Speed 30 net words per minute (NWPM)
Marks for Typing Test 15
Evaluation Done by software, based on both speed and accuracy

How Is Typing Speed Calculated in the SKAU Typing Test?

SKAU has published a formula for the net typing speed. One word is counted as 5 strokes, including spaces. Every error and every skipped word leads to a deduction of 5 strokes.

Step Formula
Gross Strokes Total typed strokes
Deduction (Number of errors + Number of skipped words) × 5
Net Strokes Gross strokes − Deduction
Net Speed (WPM) Net strokes ÷ (5 × Test duration in minutes)

Example from the official formula sheet: a candidate with 2,500 gross strokes, 20 errors and 10 skipped words in a 10-minute test has a deduction of 150 strokes, net strokes of 2,350 and a net speed of 47 words per minute.

How the Typing Test Works on the Computer

The official step-by-step guide explains the test process as follows.

  1. Open the typing test software on the desktop and check that the keyboard and mouse allotted to you work properly.
  2. Select the declaration confirming that you have checked the keyboard and mouse, then click Next.
  3. On the login window, enter your Roll Number and Batch Number as printed on the admit card, and the Batch ID that is told to you in the examination hall.
  4. The typing window has two parts. The upper part shows the text to be typed and the lower part is where you type.
  5. Press the Space Bar to start the test. The text appears and the timer starts together.
  6. When the time is over, a time-up message appears and an evaluation sheet is generated.

SKAU Typing Test Instructions for Candidates

These instructions come from the official typing test instruction sheet. Read them before the exam.

  • Check that Caps Lock and Num Lock are in the correct state before you start.
  • Type in sync with the text highlighted in red in the upper half of the window. Content typed out of sync is counted as errors, and a skipped or missed word is also an error.
  • You can correct a mistake in a word with the Backspace key only before you press the Space Bar. Once the Space Bar is pressed after a word, that word cannot be corrected.
  • Key combinations such as Ctrl+F4, Alt+F4, Ctrl+Esc, Ctrl+Alt+Delete, Alt+Tab, Alt+Space, Alt+Esc, the right-click key and the Windows key with a function key are not allowed.
  • Using a prohibited key or tampering with the data or software can lead to cancellation of candidature and action under the Information Technology Act, 2000.
  • Do not look at other candidates' screens and do not talk to each other.
  • Mobile phones, pagers and other communication devices are not allowed inside the exam centre.

  • Login ID / Registration Number

How to Download IBPS PO Mains Admit Card 2026?

Follow these steps to download your IBPS PO Mains call letter online:

  1. Visit the official IBPS website, ibps.in, or use the direct link given above.
  2. Click on "CRP-PO/MT" on the homepage.
  3. Select "Recruitment Process for Probationary Officer CRP PO/MT CRP-XVI".

  6. Your IBPS PO Mains Admit Card 2026 will be displayed on the screen.

Forgot Registration Number or Password?

If you have misplaced your registration number or password, you can retrieve it using the steps below:

  1. Visit the official website, ibps.in.
  2. On the login page, click on the PO/MT examination admit card link.
  3. Click on the "Forgot Password?" button.
  4. Enter your registration number along with your registered mobile number or email ID.
  5. Click submit a new password will be sent to your registered email.

Important Instructions for the IBPS PO Mains Exam

Candidates must follow these exam-day guidelines carefully:

  • Carry a printed copy of the IBPS PO Mains Admit Card along with an original valid photo ID proof.
  • Reach the exam centre at least 30 to 45 minutes before the reporting time mentioned on the call letter.
  • Carry 2 to 3 passport-size photographs identical to the one uploaded on the call letter.
  • Electronic devices, smartwatches, calculators, Bluetooth devices, and study materials are not allowed inside the exam hall.
  • Biometric verification will be conducted at the exam centre to maintain the integrity of the process.
  • Ensure the photograph and signature printed on the admit card are clear and legible.
  • Scribe-related documents are required only for candidates using a registered scribe under PwBD guidelines.

Documents Required for the IBPS PO Mains Exam

Candidates must carry the following mandatory documents to the exam centre:

  • Printed IBPS PO Mains Call Letter / Admit Card
  • Original photo identity proof (Aadhaar Card/e-Aadhaar, PAN Card, Voter ID, Driving Licence, or Passport), along with a photocopy
  • 2 to 3 extra passport-size photographs matching the one on the call letter
  • Scribe-related documents, only if applicable

Details Mentioned on the IBPS PO Mains Admit Card

Once downloaded, candidates should verify the following details printed on the call letter and report any discrepancy to IBPS immediately:

  • Candidate's Name, Photograph, and Signature
  • Father's/Mother's or Husband's Name
  • Date of Birth, Gender, and Category
  • Roll Number/User ID and Registration Number
  • Post Applied (CRP PO/MT CRP-XVI)
  • Exam Date, Stage, and Shift Timing
  • Name, Code, and Complete Address of the Exam Centre
  • Reporting Time and Gate-Closing Instructions
  • Space for candidate's signature and left thumb impression
  • Exam-day rules and instructions

What to Do in Case of an Error on the Admit Card?

If you notice any mistake or discrepancy on your IBPS PO Mains Admit Card, follow these steps:

  1. Verify your name spelling, date of birth, registration number, and category carefully.
  2. Check whether your photograph and signature are clearly visible.
  3. Confirm the centre name, shift timing, and full address are correct.
  4. Contact the IBPS helpdesk through the official support email or helpline number given on the portal.
  5. Keep your online application form and registration acknowledgement ready for faster resolution.
  6. Download the corrected admit card once the issue has been updated by IBPS.

IBPS PO Mains Exam Date and Pattern 2026

The IBPS PO Mains exam will be held on 4 October 2026. It is a Computer-Based Test that evaluates candidates on Reasoning & Computer Aptitude, General/Economy/Banking Awareness, English Language, and Data Analysis & Interpretation, along with a descriptive English Language Writing Test (Essay & Letter). Negative marking applies for wrong answers in the objective sections. Exact sectional timings, marks distribution, and negative-marking ratio are not available in the source material used for this article and should be checked on the admit card and the official notification.

Class  Eligibility 
Primary Level Teachers (Class 1 to 5)
  • Candidates must have passed 10+2 (Intermediate) with at least 50% marks (or 45% as per NCTE rules) along with or appearing in a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (BTC/D.El.Ed), or a 4-year B.El.Ed, or a 2-year Diploma in Special Education. Alternatively, candidates with a Bachelor’s degree and pursuing or completed a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education are also eligible.

The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs), under the Ministry of Railways, Government of India, have released the RRB NTPC Graduate Recruitment 2026 notification under CEN No. 06/2026 for 3,548 vacancies in Non-Technical Popular Categories (Graduate).

The recruitment includes Chief Commercial cum Ticket Supervisor, Goods Train Manager, Junior Accounts Assistant cum Typist and Senior Clerk cum Typist posts. Eligible graduates can submit the online application from 08 October 2026 to 06 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.

Candidates can check the RRB NTPC Graduate vacancy, salary, qualification, age limit, application fee, selection process, CBT exam pattern, application procedure, signature size and other important details below.

On this Page
  • Overview | Important Dates | Vacancy & Salary | Eligibility Age Limit | Application Fee | Selection Process | Exam Pattern | How to Apply Photo & Signature Size Signature Compressor | Important Instructions | Important Links

RRB NTPC Graduate Recruitment 2026 Overview

RRB NTPC Graduate CEN 06/2026 is being conducted for recruitment to four graduate-level Non-Technical Popular Category posts in Indian Railways.

Recruiting Body Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs)
Ministry Ministry of Railways, Government of India
Recruitment Name RRB NTPC Graduate Recruitment 2026
CEN No. 06/2026
Category Non-Technical Popular Categories (Graduate)
Total Vacancies 3,548
Qualification Degree from a recognized University or equivalent
Age Limit 18 to 33 years as on 01 January 2027
Apply Mode Online
Application Start Date 08 October 2026
Last Date 06 November 2026, 11:59 PM
Selection Process CBT 1, CBT 2, Document Verification and Medical Examination

RRB NTPC Graduate Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Event Date
Indicative Notice in Employment News 26 September 2026
Online Application Start Date 08 October 2026
Last Date to Apply Online 06 November 2026, 11:59 PM
Last Date for Application Fee Payment 08 November 2026
Application Modification Window 09 November to 18 November 2026
CBT Exam Date To be notified
Document Verification To be notified

Dates for the Computer Based Tests, Document Verification and other recruitment stages will be announced separately by the Railway Recruitment Boards.

RRB NTPC Graduate Vacancy and Salary 2026

A total of 3,548 vacancies have been announced under RRB NTPC Graduate CEN 06/2026. The highest number of vacancies is for Goods Train Manager with 2,750 posts.

Post Name Vacancies 7th CPC Level Initial Pay Medical Standard
Chief Commercial cum Ticket Supervisor 127 Level 6 ₹35,400 B2
Goods Train Manager 2,750 Level 5 ₹29,200 A2
Junior Accounts Assistant cum Typist 300 Level 5 ₹29,200 C2
Senior Clerk cum Typist 371 Level 5 ₹29,200 C2
Total 3,548 - - -

The RRB-wise, Railway Zone-wise and post-wise distribution of vacancies is provided in Annexure B of CEN No. 06/2026. The notified vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease depending on Railway requirements.

RRB NTPC Graduate Eligibility 2026

RRB NTPC Graduate Educational Qualification

Candidates must possess a Degree from a recognized University or its equivalent for all four posts under RRB NTPC Graduate CEN 06/2026.

Post Minimum Qualification
Chief Commercial cum Ticket Supervisor Degree from a recognized University or equivalent
Goods Train Manager Degree from a recognized University or equivalent
Junior Accounts Assistant cum Typist Degree from a recognized University or equivalent
Senior Clerk cum Typist Degree from a recognized University or equivalent

Candidates must possess the prescribed educational qualification on or before 06 November 2026. Candidates awaiting the final result of the qualifying examination are not eligible to apply.

Is Typing Skill Test Required for RRB NTPC Graduate 2026?

No. The Typing Skill Test for Junior Accounts Assistant cum Typist and Senior Clerk cum Typist has been dispensed with for CEN No. 06/2026.

However, candidates appointed to these posts are expected to have basic computer and typing proficiency. Their proficiency may be assessed after joining, and unsatisfactory performance may affect or delay confirmation or promotion.

RRB NTPC Graduate Age Limit 2026

The age limit for all posts under CEN No. 06/2026 is calculated as on 01 January 2027.

Minimum Age 18 years
Maximum Age 33 years
UR / EWS Date of Birth Not earlier than 02 January 1994
OBC-NCL Date of Birth Not earlier than 02 January 1991
SC / ST Date of Birth Not earlier than 02 January 1989
Lower Age DOB Limit Not born after 01 January 2009

RRB NTPC Graduate Age Relaxation

Category Age Relaxation
SC / ST 5 years
OBC-NCL 3 years
PwBD – UR / EWS 10 years
PwBD – OBC-NCL 13 years
PwBD – SC / ST 15 years
Ex-Servicemen As prescribed in CEN 06/2026 after deduction of qualifying military service

Additional age concessions are available to eligible serving Railway employees, Quasi-Administrative Railway employees, widowed/divorced/judicially separated women and other specified categories as mentioned in the official notification.

RRB NTPC Graduate Application Fee 2026

Category Application Fee Refund after Appearing in CBT 1
All candidates except concession categories ₹500 ₹400, after deduction of applicable bank charges
SC / ST / Ex-Servicemen / PwBD / Female / Transgender / Minorities / EBC ₹250 ₹250, after deduction of applicable bank charges

The examination fee can be paid online through Internet Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI.

Important: The fee refund is available only to candidates who actually appear in the 1st Stage CBT.

Economically Backward Class (EBC), Economically Weaker Section (EWS) and OBC are different categories. EBC under this CEN is relevant to the fee concession and should not be confused with EWS reservation.

RRB NTPC Graduate Selection Process 2026

The recruitment process for RRB NTPC Graduate CEN 06/2026 consists of:

  1. 1st Stage Computer Based Test (CBT 1)
  2. 2nd Stage Computer Based Test (CBT 2)
  3. Document Verification
  4. Medical Examination

There is no Typing Skill Test under CEN 06/2026, including for Junior Accounts Assistant cum Typist and Senior Clerk cum Typist.

Candidates will be shortlisted for Document Verification RRB-wise in the ratio of approximately 1:1 against the notified vacancies, based on merit and the applicable recruitment rules.

RRB NTPC Graduate Exam Pattern 2026

RRB NTPC CBT 1 Exam Pattern

Subject Questions Marks
General Awareness 40 40
Mathematics 30 30
General Intelligence & Reasoning 30 30
Total 100 100

Duration: 90 minutes.

Eligible PwBD/PwD candidates using a scribe will receive 120 minutes.

Negative Marking: One-third (1/3) mark will be deducted for every wrong answer.

RRB NTPC CBT 2 Exam Pattern

Subject Questions Marks
General Awareness 50 50
Mathematics 35 35
General Intelligence & Reasoning 35 35
Total 120 120

Duration: 90 minutes.

Negative Marking: One-third (1/3) mark will be deducted for each incorrect answer.

RRB NTPC Minimum Qualifying Marks

Category Minimum Qualifying Marks
UR 40%
EWS 40%
OBC-NCL 30%
SC 30%
ST 25%

The minimum qualifying marks may be relaxed by 2 marks for PwBD candidates in case of a shortage of PwBD candidates against reserved vacancies.

RRB NTPC Syllabus 2026

RRB NTPC Graduate Apply Online 2026

The RRB NTPC Graduate online application process starts on 08 October 2026. Candidates must complete their application by 06 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.

How to Apply for RRB NTPC Graduate Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official RRB application portal.
  2. Open the application for CEN No. 06/2026 – NTPC Graduate.
  3. Select Create an Account if you do not already have an RRB account.
  4. Candidates who created an account for earlier RRB CENs in 2024, 2025 or 2026 should use the same login credentials.
  5. Complete Aadhaar/DigiLocker identity authentication where applicable.
  6. Select only one RRB carefully.
  7. Enter personal, educational, category and other required details.
  8. Choose eligible Railway/Production Unit and post preferences.
  9. Capture the live photograph through the application portal.
  10. Upload the signature in the prescribed format.
  11. Pay the applicable examination fee.
  12. Preview all information carefully.
  13. Submit the application before 06 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.
  14. Save the registration details and submitted application for future reference.

Important: Candidates must submit only one application against CEN No. 06/2026. Multiple applications to the same or different RRBs can lead to rejection of all applications and debarment from future RRB/RRC examinations.

RRB NTPC Application Correction Window 2026

The application modification window will be open from 09 November to 18 November 2026.

Candidates can modify eligible application details by paying a ₹250 non-refundable modification fee for each occasion.

Details entered under Create an Account, including mobile number and email ID, and the Chosen RRB cannot be changed.

RRB NTPC Graduate Photo and Signature Size 2026

For RRB NTPC Graduate CEN 06/2026, candidates are not required to upload a pre-existing passport photograph. The application portal will capture a live photograph during the online application process.

RRB NTPC Live Photo Requirements

  • The photograph must be captured live using a computer/laptop webcam or mobile phone front camera.
  • Use a pure plain white background.
  • Wear non-white clothing, preferably a plain dark colour, to maintain contrast.
  • Look directly at the camera with a neutral expression.
  • The entire face must be clearly visible and centered.
  • The head should occupy at least 50% of the photograph area.
  • Do not wear a cap, mask or spectacles while capturing the photograph.
  • Do not photograph a printed or existing digital photograph.

Important: Since the photograph is captured live, there is no separate RRB NTPC photo upload size or KB requirement for a pre-existing photograph under CEN 06/2026.

RRB NTPC Signature Size 2026

File Format JPG / JPEG
File Size 30 KB to 49 KB
Minimum Dimensions 140 × 60 pixels
Scanner Resolution Minimum 100 DPI
Signature Box 35 mm × 20 mm
Ink Black ink on white paper

The signature must be written by the candidate in normal running handwriting. Signatures written in BLOCK LETTERS, CAPITAL LETTERS or disjointed letters are not accepted.

RRB NTPC Signature Compressor and Image Resizer

If the scanned signature does not meet the RRB NTPC upload requirements, candidates can use the OnlyJobs Image Resizer to resize and compress it before uploading.

For RRB NTPC Graduate CEN 06/2026, keep the signature in JPG/JPEG format, between 30 KB and 49 KB, with minimum dimensions of 140 × 60 pixels.

How to Resize RRB NTPC Signature

  1. Sign on white paper using a black ink pen.
  2. Scan the signature clearly.
  3. Open the OnlyJobs Image Resizer.
  4. Keep the image dimensions at least 140 × 60 pixels.
  5. Compress the file to between 30 KB and 49 KB.
  6. Save the final image in JPG or JPEG format.
  7. Check that the signature is complete, clear and clearly visible before uploading.

RRB NTPC Graduate Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Read CEN No. 06/2026 completely before submitting the application.
  • Applications can be submitted only through online mode.
  • Select only one RRB.
  • Submit only one application against CEN 06/2026.
  • Candidates awaiting their final graduation result are not eligible.
  • Check the medical standard applicable to each post before giving post preference.
  • Goods Train Manager requires A2 medical standard.
  • Capture the live photograph exactly according to the instructions.
  • Upload the signature only in the prescribed format and size.
  • Keep your registered mobile number and email ID active throughout the recruitment process.
  • Details entered in Create an Account and the selected RRB cannot be changed later.
  • Check all details carefully before the application deadline.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

Canara Bank Graduate Apprentice Notification 2026 has been released on the official website. A total of 3500 vacancies have been announced through the Canara Bank Graduate Apprentice Recruitment 2026.

Candidates aged between 20 and 28 years who have a Degree (Graduation) in any discipline from a university recognized by the Government of India, passed not earlier than 01.01.2023 and not later than 01.09.2026 are eligible to apply for these Graduate Apprentice vacancies. The online application process for Canara Bank Graduate Apprentice Recruitment 2026 will remain open until 17-10-2026.

Candidates can download the official notification PDF and apply online through the direct links provided below in this article.

Canara Bank Graduate Apprentice Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF

Candidates who are interested in applying for the Canara Bank Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/ salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form.

  • Download Canara Bank Graduate Apprentice Job 2026 Notification PDF
  • Apply Online

Canara Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Overview

Canara Bank has published the advertisement "Engagement of Graduate Apprentices under Apprentices Act, 1961 for FY 2026-27". Candidates must first register on the apprenticeship portal and then apply through the Bank's website.

Post Name Graduate Apprentice

Important Points About Training Seats

  • Candidates can opt for training seats in only ONE STATE under this project.
  • Candidates will be able to give their order of preference for all districts in the selected state. Allotment will be need based and subject to availability of training seats in the respective districts.
  • The Bank reserves the right to allot a training seat in any district of the selected state as per administrative requirement.
  • Candidates should ensure they fulfil the eligibility criteria as on the date of eligibility before applying.
  • Candidates should check the Bank's website (www.canarabank.bank.in, Careers, Recruitment, Engagement of Graduate Apprentices in Canara Bank under Apprentices Act, 1961 for FY 2026-27) for details and updates.

Canara Bank Apprentice Eligibility Criteria

All eligibility conditions, including age and qualification, are computed as on 01.09.2026 (inclusive). The tables below summarise the main conditions.

Canara Bank Apprentice Qualification

 
Educational Qualification A Degree (Graduation) in any discipline from a university recognized by the Govt. of India, or any equivalent qualification recognized as such by the Central Government.
Graduation Passing Window Candidates must have passed their Graduation not earlier than 01.01.2023 and not later than 01.09.2026 (both days inclusive).
Test of Local Language Candidates who produce a 10th or 12th standard mark sheet/ certificate showing they studied the opted local language will not have to take the local language test. For other candidates, the test will be conducted when they are called for Document Verification. Candidates who fail to qualify will not be engaged as apprentices.
Physical/ Medical Fitness Engagement is subject to the candidate being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Bank.
Portal Registration Candidates need a 100% complete profile on https:/ / nats.education.gov.in before applying.

Canara Bank Apprentice Age Limit

The age limit is a minimum of 20 years and a maximum of 28 years as on 01.09.2026. Candidates must have been born not earlier than 02.09.1998 and not later than 01.09.2006 (both days inclusive). The maximum age limit applies to General Category and EWS candidates.

 
Sl. No. Category Age Relaxation
1 Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe 5 years
2 Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years
3 Persons with Benchmark Disabilities as defined under "The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016" 10 years
4 Widows, divorced women and women legally separated from their husbands who have not remarried Age concession up to the age of 35 years for General/ EWS, 38 years for OBC and 40 years for SC/ ST candidates

Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

Other Eligibility Conditions and Notes

  1. Age relaxation for SC/ ST/ OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates is allowed on a cumulative basis with only one of the remaining categories for which age relaxation is permitted.
  2. Candidates seeking age relaxation must submit the necessary certificate(s) in original along with photocopies at the time of document verification/ reporting for On-the-Job training and at any later stage required by the Bank.
  3. Reservation for PwBD is horizontal and within the overall training vacancies for the State.
  4. No Ex-servicemen/ Disabled Ex-Servicemen shall be engaged as an apprentice, and there is no reservation for them in this engagement.
  5. The candidate should not have undergone Apprenticeship Training with Canara Bank or any other organization earlier, should not be pursuing Apprenticeship Training under the Apprentices Act 1961, and should not have been terminated during Apprenticeship Training due to their own fault.
  6. Candidates who have undergone training or have job experience of one or more years after completing their educational qualification are not eligible.
  7. SC/ ST/ OBC/ PwBD candidates need a Caste/ Category Certificate issued by a competent authority in the format prescribed by the Government of India.
  8. OBC candidates need a valid OBC certificate with a non-creamy layer clause. OBC candidates who come under the creamy layer are not entitled to OBC reservation and should indicate their category as General in the online application.

Canara Bank Apprentice Reservation Details

Reservation for SC/ ST/ OBC/ EWS/ PwBD candidates is as per the prescribed reservation percentages of the respective States/ UTs as per Government guidelines. Candidates from reserved categories, including those for whom no reservation is mentioned, may apply for unreserved vacancies if they fulfil all eligibility conditions applicable to the unreserved category.

PwBD Reservation

Under section 34 of "The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016", persons with benchmark disabilities are eligible for reservation. The post is identified as suitable for the following disability categories as defined in the Schedule of the RPwD Act 2016.

  • Visual Impairment (VI): Persons with blindness (total absence of sight; visual acuity less than 3/ 60 or less than 10/ 200 (Snellen) in the better eye with best possible correction; or limitation of the field of vision subtending an angle of less than 10 degrees) or low vision (visual acuity not exceeding 6/ 18 or less than 20/ 60 up to 3/ 60 or up to 10/ 200 (Snellen) in the better eye with best possible correction; or limitation of the field of vision subtending an angle of less than 40 degrees up to 10 degrees).
  • Hearing Impaired (HI): Deaf (70 DB hearing loss in speech frequencies in both ears) or Hard of Hearing (60 DB to 70 DB hearing loss in speech frequencies in both ears).
  • Orthopedically Challenged/ Locomotor Disability (OC/ LD): Inability to execute distinctive activities associated with movement of self and objects resulting from affliction of the musculoskeletal or nervous system or both, including Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism (adult height of 4 feet 10 inches (147 centimeters) or less), Muscular Dystrophy, Acid Attack Victims, Spinal Deformity and Spinal Injury without any associated neurological/ limb dysfunction.
  • Intellectual Disability (ID): Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), Specific Learning Disability (SLD) and Mental Illness (MI), as defined in the notification.
  • Multiple Disabilities: Multiple disabilities among the categories above.

Only persons with benchmark disabilities are eligible for reservation. A benchmark disability means not less than 40% of a specified disability, as certified by the certifying authority. Candidates must submit a disability certificate issued by a Competent Authority as per Government of India guidelines, which is subject to verification or re-verification at any point. PwBD reservation is not applicable on the basis of a temporary disability certificate. It is only for persons with irreversible permanent benchmark disability in terms of O.M. No. 36035/ 8/ 2023-Estt. (Res-II) dated 19.05.2023 of DoPT. Government guidelines may change from time to time.

EWS Reservation

  • Persons not covered under the reservation schemes for SC, ST and OBC, and whose family gross annual income is below Rs. 8.00 lakh, are identified as EWS. Income includes all sources (salary, agriculture, business, profession, etc.) for the financial year prior to the year of application.
  • Families owning any of these assets are excluded irrespective of income: 5 acres of agricultural land and above; a residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. and above; a residential plot of 100 sq. yards and above in notified municipalities; a residential plot of 200 sq. yards and above in areas other than notified municipalities.
  • Property held in different locations or cities is clubbed for the land or property holding test.
  • The EWS benefit requires an Income and Asset Certificate issued by a Competent Authority in the format prescribed by the Government of India. Shortlisted candidates must bring it at document verification.
  • "Family" includes the candidate, parents and siblings below 18 years, and the spouse and children below 18 years.

Disclaimer in the notification: EWS vacancies are tentative and subject to further directives of the Government of India and the outcome of any litigation.

Canara Bank Apprentice Stipend and Salary

Apprentices are not employees of Canara Bank. A monthly stipend is paid instead of a salary during the apprenticeship period.

 
Monthly Stipend Rs. 16,650 (including subsidy amount, if any, by Govt. of India)
Paid by Canara Bank Rs. 10,500 per month into the apprentice's account
Government Share Rs. 6,150, credited directly to the apprentice's bank account through DBT mode as per extant guidelines
Deductions Stipend is paid each month after adjusting loss of pay, if any
Other Allowances/ Benefits Not eligible for any other allowances or benefits

Canara Bank Apprentice Application Fee

The fee is non-refundable and includes GST. It is payable online only.

 
Category Application Fee / Intimation Charges (Non-Refundable)
SC/ ST/ PwBD NIL
All Others Rs. 500 (incl. intimation charges)

Payment can be made by Debit Cards (RuPay/ Visa/ MasterCard/ Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards or Mobile Wallets. An e-receipt is generated after a successful transaction. Candidates should not press Back or Refresh after submitting payment information, to avoid double charge.

Canara Bank Apprentice Selection Process

Selection is merit-based. The notification does not describe a written examination.

  1. Merit list: Prepared state-wise in descending order of marks/ percentage in 12th Std (HSC/ 10+2)/ Diploma Examination. Ties are ranked by age in descending order.
  2. Minimum marks: Not less than 60% (55% for SC/ ST/ PwBD) in 12th Std/ Diploma. Fractions are ignored, so 59.99% is treated as below 60% and 54.99% as below 55%.
  3. Document Verification and local language test: Conducted during the Document Verification process. Original documents are checked. Any discrepancy leads to summary disqualification.
  4. Final selection is subject to verification of eligibility and application information, qualification in the local language test of the opted State where applicable, and being declared medically fit.

Where CGPA/ OGPA is awarded, it must be converted into percentage in the online application, with a certificate from the appropriate authority stating the conversion norms. Percentage is total marks obtained in all subjects in all semesters/ years divided by aggregate maximum marks, multiplied by 100. The merit list is prepared only on the information submitted in the online application.

How to Apply for Canara Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026

Candidates must apply online. No other mode of application will be accepted.

Canara Bank Apprentice Apply Online

  1. Register on https:/ / nats.education.gov.in and complete your profile to 100%. Keep the enrollment number generated.
  2. Visit www.canarabank.bank.in, open Careers, then Recruitment, then the link "Engagement of Graduate Apprentices in Canara Bank under Apprentices Act, 1961 for FY 2026-27".
  3. Click "CLICK HERE FOR NEW REGISTRATION" and enter basic information. A provisional registration number and password are generated and sent by email and SMS. Saved data can be reopened using them.
  4. Enter the NATS enrollment ID, fill all fields, and choose one State along with district preferences.
  5. Upload the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration as specified below.
  6. Use "SAVE AND NEXT" to verify details. No change is possible after clicking FINAL SUBMIT.
  7. Pay the fee online (if applicable), then take a printout of the application and e-receipt.

Apply well before the closing date to avoid website load issues. Only one application should be submitted; if multiple are submitted, only the latest valid completed application is retained.

Documents Required to Apply Online

Upload Specifications
Document Dimensions (preferred) File Size Other Requirements
Photograph (4.5cm x 3.5cm) 200 x 230 pixels 20 KB to 50 KB Recent colour passport-style photo on a light background; caps, hats and dark glasses not accepted
Signature 140 x 60 pixels 10 KB to 20 KB Black ink on white paper; CAPITAL LETTERS not accepted
Left thumb impression 240 x 240 pixels at 200 DPI (3cm x 3cm) 20 KB to 50 KB jpg/ jpeg; black or blue ink on white paper
Handwritten declaration 800 x 400 pixels at 200 DPI (10cm x 5cm) 50 KB to 100 KB jpg/ jpeg; English, black ink, own handwriting, not in CAPITAL LETTERS

The declaration text is: "I, ____ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required." Candidates without a left thumb may use the right thumb or other alternatives given in the notification, and must mention the finger and hand/ toe used in the uploaded document. Candidates who cannot write may type the declaration and put their left thumb impression below it. Images should be scanned at a minimum of 200 dpi in true colour, in JPG/ JPEG format. Unclear or smudged images may lead to rejection.

Candidates also need a valid personal email ID and mobile number, active until the process ends, and should spell their name as in the SSC/ SSLC/ X Standard marks card (or as per Gazette Notification/ Marriage Certificate if changed). An application that is incomplete or has unsuccessful fee payment is invalid. If no email/ SMS intimation is received, the application is considered not successfully registered.

Documents to Be Produced at the Time of Engagement

Originals with a self-attested photocopy must be submitted, failing which the candidate may not be permitted to join.

  • Valid system-generated printout of the online application.
  • Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate from a Competent Authority or SSLC/ Std. X Certificate with date of birth).
  • Photo ID: Passport, Aadhar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID, Driving License or any other photo ID issued by Statutory Authorities.
  • Mark sheets/ certificates from SSC onwards to the highest examination passed, including semester/ year-wise mark sheets and the final degree, with proper Board/ University proof that the result was declared on or before the cut-off date.
  • Income and Asset Certificate in the prescribed format (EWS candidates).
  • Caste Certificate in the prescribed format (SC/ ST/ OBC). For OBC, the certificate must include the non-creamy layer clause, be valid as on the date of notification, and the caste name must tally letter by letter with the Government list.
  • UDID card and Disability Certificate from a Medical Board (at least three members, including a specialist) in the prescribed format (PwBD candidates).
  • Any other relevant documents in support of eligibility.

Garhwalis, Kumaonis, Dogras, Marathas & Assam/HP/J&K/Ladakh 165.0 cm 155.0 cm
NE States (Arunachal, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, Tripura) 162.5 cm 152.5 cm
Gorkha Territorial Administration (Darjeeling/Kalimpong/Kurseong) 157.0 cm 152.5 cm

Chest (Male Only)

  • General: Unexpanded 80 cm, minimum expansion 5 cm
  • Scheduled Tribe: Unexpanded 76 cm, minimum expansion 5 cm
  • Garhwalis/Kumaonis/Dogras/Marathas/Assam/HP/J&K/Ladakh: Unexpanded 78 cm, minimum expansion 5 cm
  • NE States (Arunachal, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, Tripura) & GTA: Unexpanded 77 cm, minimum expansion 5 cm

Weight: Proportionate to height and age as per the medical standards chart (Annexure-I).

Medical Standards

  • Minimum distance vision 6/6 and 6/9 in both eyes without correction (glasses/lenses not permitted); binocular vision required; colour vision tested by CP III (Ishihara)
  • Colour-blind candidates are not eligible
  • No knock-knees, flat foot, varicose veins, or squint; must be in good mental and bodily health
  • Tattoos: only religious symbols/figures/names permitted, on the left forearm (inner aspect) or dorsum of hands only, sized under ¼ of that body part

ITBP Constable (GD) Sports Quota Pay Scale

Pay Level (7th CPC) Pay Range
Level-3 ₹21,700 – ₹69,100
Also includes Dearness Allowance, Ration Money, Washing Allowance, Special Compensatory Allowance (border postings), free uniform, free accommodation/HRA, Transport Allowance, free Leave Pass, free medical facilities, and other admissible allowances. Pension under the New Restructured Defined Contributory Pension Scheme (w.e.f. 01.01.2004).

ITBP Constable (GD) Sports Quota Selection Process & Marking Scheme

Selection follows: Documentation → Physical Standard Test (PST) → Sports Trial Test (qualifying) → Merit List (based on sports achievement marks) → Detailed Medical Examination (DME) → Review Medical Examination (RME), if required. There is no written examination.

Sports Achievement Marking Scheme (Selected Rows)

Competition Gold Silver Bronze Participation
Olympic Games (Summer & Winter) 100 92 84 75
Asian Games 85 77 69 60
Commonwealth Games 80 72 64 55
World Championship/World Cup (Annual) 70 62 54 45
National Games / Senior National Championship 30 22 17 Not eligible
Junior National Championship 25 18 15 Not eligible
Inter-University / Khelo India University Games 20 13 11 Not eligible
Khelo India Youth/Winter Games 15 12 10 Not eligible
The official notification lists 18 competition tiers in total (including Youth Olympics, World Championship Quadrennial/Biennial, Junior World Championship, Asian Championship Quadrennial/Biennial/Annual, Junior Asian Championship, World University Games, and other MYA&S-cleared international events). Candidates get marks for only the single highest medal/participation secured in the 01.01.2024–01.11.2026 window.

Documentation, PST & Sports Trial Test

  • Documentation: Verification of original certificates (age, education, caste, sports achievement); identity/biometric verification is mandatory
  • Physical Standard Test (PST): Height, chest (male only) and weight checked against the standards above; over/underweight candidates are not debarred at this stage – final fitness decision rests with the Medical Officer at DME
  • Sports Trial Test: 40 marks, qualifying in nature, minimum cut-off 20 marks (does not count toward final merit); exempted for candidates who represented India in an International Sports Event with Department of Sports clearance
  • No appeal is entertained for re-conduct of the Sports Trial Test

Merit List & Tie-Breaking

  • Final merit is based purely on the sports achievement marking scheme (Documentation + PST + Sports Trial marks are not added to merit, only used for shortlisting/qualifying)
  • Tie-break order: (1) higher marks, (2) higher National-competition achievement if International achievements are equal, (3) younger candidate, (4) alphabetical order of name in English

Medical Examination

  • Detailed Medical Examination (DME) conducted per MHA's Uniform Guidelines for Recruitment Medical Examination (dated 20.05.2015, as amended)
  • Candidates declared unfit may opt for Review Medical Examination (RME) by giving written consent within 24 hours; the RME decision is final
  • Pregnant female candidates are declared temporarily unfit; their vacancy is held and they are re-examined 6 weeks after confinement, subject to a fitness certificate

How to Apply for ITBP Constable (GD) Sports Quota Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit recruitment.itbpolice.nic.in and create a candidate profile with a genuine, active e-mail ID and mobile number.
  2. Upload a copy of the certificate/document supporting your highest medal/position or highest level of sports participation in the advertised duration before applying – applications without this are rejected during scrutiny.
  3. Complete the online application form carefully.
  4. Pay the application fee online, if applicable to your category.
  5. Submit before the closing date: 01 November 2026, 11:59 PM. Offline applications are summarily rejected.

Application Fee

Category Fee
Male UR/OBC/EWS ₹100
Female (any category) / SC / ST Exempted (Nil)
Important: Fee once paid is non-refundable, and payment via any mode other than the ITBPF website leads to summary rejection.

Documents Required

  • Matriculation/10th class certificate (proof of date of birth)
  • Sports achievement certificate(s), signed by the competent awarding authority (National Federation Secretary, IOA, University Dean of Sports, or SAI, depending on the competition level)
  • OBC certificate (Annexure-III) with Non-Creamy-Layer declaration (Annexure-III(A)), SC/ST certificate (Annexure-IV), or EWS certificate valid for 2025-26 (Annexure-V), as applicable
  • No Objection Certificate (Annexure-II), for candidates in Government service
  • Certificate for height/chest relaxation (Annexure-VI), if claiming this relaxation
  • Domicile certificate issued by local revenue authorities (special format, Annexure-VI(A), for West Pakistani Refugees in J&K/Ladakh)
  • Four latest passport-size photographs (same as used in the online application)

Important Conditions

  • These vacancies are not open to physically challenged persons or ex-servicemen
  • Selected candidates must serve a minimum of 10 years in the Force; resigning earlier requires refunding 3 months' pay/allowances or training cost, whichever is higher
  • No TA/DA is admissible for travel to/from the recruitment venue; candidates should be prepared for a multi-day stay at their own arrangement and cost
  • Possession of mobile phones, firearms, or any gadget at the recruitment venue, impersonation, forged documents, or misbehaviour with recruitment staff leads to cancellation of candidature and possible police/legal action
  • Admit cards are issued only online; ITBPF is not responsible for non-receipt due to invalid contact details or technical issues
  • ITBPF reserves the right to change the recruitment procedure, cancel or postpone recruitment, or transfer unfilled vacancies between disciplines/categories

📄 Complete Details & Notification

LIC Housing Finance Limited (LIC HFL), the housing finance company promoted by LIC, is recruiting 50 Management Trainees in Marketing and Sales for a one-year training programme with absorption into the company afterwards, subject to its criteria. During training the stipend is Rs. 40,000 to 50,000 a month (Rs. 4.8 to 6 lakh a year); the listing states a CTC of 14 lakh and above on absorption. An MBA is mandatory; freshers are eligible, with 0 to 1 year of sales experience preferred, and fluency in the local language is required.

The posts are spread across 35 cities from Chandigarh and Delhi to Chennai, Bangalore and Guwahati, and applicants must be residents of one of them. Selected trainees sign a two-year service bond. Applications are made through Internshala by 25 October 2026; the listing already shows more than 1,000 applicants. This is a corporate trainee role, not a government post: there is no examination, fee or reservation described.

Download LIC HFL Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Notification Link

LIC HFL Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Quick Facts

Company LIC Housing Finance Limited (LIC HFL), lichousing.com
Role Management Trainee, Marketing & Sales; one-year management training programme with absorption subject to prescribed criteria
Openings 50
Who can apply MBA holders (mandatory), freshers or with up to one year of sales experience, resident in one of the 35 listed cities, fluent in the local language
Stipend during training Rs. 40,000 to 50,000 a month (shown on the listing as CTC Rs. 4,80,000 to 6,00,000 a year)
CTC on absorption 14 lakh a year and above, as stated in the listing
Service bond Minimum two years from the date of joining
Off days Second and fourth Saturdays of every month
Start date Immediately
Apply by 25 October 2026
Application Online through the Internshala listing (sign-up and profile required)
Application fee Not mentioned
Age limit Not stated
Selection process Not described on the listing

Role and Requirements

What the trainee does

The programme is built around housing finance sales. The listing groups the work into three areas:

  • Sales and business development: identify, approach and acquire customers through online and offline channels to meet targets; source housing loans, loans against property and other retail loans; build relationships with builders and developers and identify projects for APF and Mini-APF approval.
  • Customer and channel relationships: guide customers on product features, eligibility and documentation; support the in-house sales team; manage Direct Selling Agents and Marketing Intermediaries, monitor their productivity and train them.
  • Credit assessment and market intelligence: carry out preliminary loan appraisal and underwriting under the company's credit policy; coordinate with internal teams on loan processing and project evaluation; track market trends and report business feedback.

Skills the listing names: business development, client relationship management, effective communication, field sales, negotiation and sales. The role is field-facing; the listing does not describe it as remote.

Eligibility

  • MBA degree is mandatory. The listing does not restrict the year of passing or the specialisation.
  • Experience: none required; 0 to 1 year in sales and negotiation is preferred. Candidates with more experience are not excluded by the listing, but it is addressed to freshers.
  • Language: fluency in the local language of the city applied for.
  • Residence: applicants must be from one of the 35 cities listed below; the listing does not accept applications from elsewhere.
  • Strong negotiation ability is stated as a requirement.

Compensation and Terms

The listing shows two pay figures that read as a contradiction until the structure of the programme is understood:

  • Training year: a stipend of Rs. 40,000 to 50,000. The listing's CTC field of Rs. 4,80,000 to 6,00,000 a year is this stipend multiplied by twelve, so the stipend is monthly.
  • After absorption: a CTC of 14 lakh a year or more, which applies only if the trainee is absorbed into the company at the end of the programme, subject to LIC HFL's prescribed criteria. Absorption is not guaranteed by the listing.
  • Service bond: a minimum of two years from the date of joining. The listing does not state the bond amount or its terms; ask before accepting an offer.
  • Leave and hours: second and fourth Saturdays off. Full-time status, working hours, probation terms, incentives and work-from-home are not disclosed on the listing.

Locations

The listing header says Pan India; the eligibility section limits applicants to residents of these 35 cities:

  • North: Chandigarh, Dehradun, Delhi, Ghaziabad, Gurgaon, Kanpur, Sonipat, Ludhiana, Jaipur, Jodhpur, Gwalior West
  • Central and East: Indore, Bhopal, Patna, Ranchi, Kolkata, Bhubaneswar, Cuttack, Guwahati, Raipur, Tripura
  • West: Mumbai, Thane, Pune, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Nagpur, Nashik
  • South: Chennai, Coimbatore, Madurai, Bangalore, Mysuru, Hyderabad, Vijayawada, Ernakulam

The listing does not say how many of the 50 openings fall in each city. Local-language fluency is tied to the city applied for.

How to Apply for LIC HFL Management Trainee Recruitment 2026

  1. Open the LIC Housing Finance Management Trainee listing on Internshala.
  2. Click Apply now. You need an Internshala account and a completed profile; the site then redirects you to the application.
  3. Answer any additional questions the application asks (the listing shows an Additional Questions section) and submit before 25 October 2026.

Before you apply

  • Confirm you live in one of the listed cities and can work in its local language; both are hard conditions in the listing.
  • Read the two-year bond as a commitment: with a training stipend of Rs. 40,000 to 50,000 and the higher CTC only on absorption, the bond terms matter more than the headline figure.
  • No application fee is mentioned. Treat any request for payment, by anyone claiming to represent LIC HFL or Internshala, as a scam.
  • The listing is on a job board, not on lichousing.com. It appears to be posted by the company itself, but applicants may also check the careers section of lichousing.com for the same opening.

  • LIC Housing Finance Limited official website

Mineral Exploration and Consultancy Limited (MECL), a Mini-Ratna-I Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Mines, Government of India, has invited online applications for 13 Executive Trainee posts in Electrical and Mechanical disciplines. This recruitment is conducted through the UPSC Engineering Services Examination (ESE) 2024 score, for candidates who cleared the written round and appeared for the ESE 2024 interview but were not recommended for final selection by UPSC. Online registration opens on 1 August 2026 and closes on 23 October 2026, through the MECL Recruitment Portal at www.mecl.co.in. Eligible candidates must hold a B.E./B.Tech in the relevant Electrical or Mechanical discipline with a minimum of 60% marks, and the maximum age limit is 28 years (UR) as on the crucial date of 1 August 2026. Selected candidates will be posted at MECL projects and offices across India.

  • MECL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
  • Date Extended Official Notification PDF

MECL Executive Trainee Eligibility Criteria

Candidates applying for the MECL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026 must meet the educational qualification and age limit given below, and must also have cleared the written round of UPSC ESE 2024, appeared for the ESE 2024 interview, and consented to sharing their score information on UPSC's website, without having been recommended for final selection.

MECL Executive Trainee Qualification

Post Essential Educational Qualification
Executive Trainee (Electrical) Minimum 60% marks in B.Tech/B.E. in Electrical Engineering / Electrical & Electronics Engineering or equivalent (courses approved by UGC & AICTE wherever applicable; ODL degrees not permissible)
Executive Trainee (Mechanical) – all divisions Minimum 60% marks in B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent (courses approved by UGC & AICTE wherever applicable; ODL degrees not permissible)

No minimum post-qualification experience is required for any of the four posts (NIL).

MECL Executive Trainee Age Limit

Category Maximum Age (as on 01 August 2026)

OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 28 years + 3 years relaxation

Ex-Servicemen As per Government of India guidelines
Internal candidates Relaxation up to 1 year, subject to CMD approval

All age relaxations are as per applicable Government of India guidelines. There is no relaxation in qualification criteria for internal candidates.

MECL Executive Trainee Salary

Selected candidates will be placed as Executive Trainees during a one-year training period at an initial Basic Pay of ₹40,000 per month in the E-1 (IDA) pay scale of ₹40,000–₹1,40,000, along with applicable Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA). In addition to Basic Pay and IDA, the posts carry other benefits including:

  • House Rent Allowance (HRA) and cafeteria-approach allowances
  • Provident Fund (PF) and National Pension System (NPS)
  • Performance Related Pay
  • Group Medical Insurance
  • MECL-Employee Defined Contributory Superannuation Scheme
  • Group Personal Accident Insurance and Term Insurance
  • Two/four-wheeler vehicle loan and house building advance, as per company guidelines

MECL Executive Trainee Application Fee

An application registration fee of ₹500 is applicable for General/OBC/EWS candidates. The fee is not applicable for SC/ST/PwD/Ex-Servicemen/Departmental candidates. Payment must be made online through Net-Banking or a QR code hosted on the MECL website under the Careers section. The fee, once paid, is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other examination or selection.

MECL Executive Trainee Selection Process

The MECL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026 selection process is based entirely on the UPSC ESE 2024 score, with no separate written examination or personal interview conducted by MECL:

  1. Applicant lists will be prepared in decreasing order of marks (out of 1200) scored in UPSC ESE 2024, category-wise, for the Mechanical/Electrical discipline.
  2. Eligible candidates will be shortlisted based on the UPSC ESE 2024 score and other eligibility criteria, as per MECL's extant Recruitment Rules.
  3. Shortlisted candidates will be called for a Document Verification round.
  4. If documents are found suitable and matching the advertisement criteria, offers of employment will be issued.

In case of a tie in total UPSC ESE 2024 score, seniority in age (as per Matriculation certificate) will be considered first, followed by a higher aggregate percentage in the essential engineering degree.

How to Apply for MECL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply for the MECL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Visit the official MECL website: www.mecl.co.in and go to the "Career" section.
  2. Register on the MECL Online Recruitment Portal with all mandatory details.
  3. Log in and click on "Apply for a Post" to fill the online application form.
  4. Enter personal details, educational qualification, UPSC ESE 2024 score, and category/community details accurately.
  5. Upload the required scanned documents in the specified format and file size.
  6. Pay the application fee (₹500 for General/OBC/EWS candidates, where applicable) online.
  7. Submit the application before the closing date of 14 August 2026.
  8. Take a printout of the system-generated application form for future reference.

Applications received through any mode other than the MECL Online Recruitment Portal will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected. Candidates are advised not to wait until the last date to apply.

MECL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026: Important Instructions

  • Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Selected candidates will undergo one year of training and may be posted at any MECL Project/Office/Establishment in India.
  • The appointee will be on probation for one year, extendable by up to one further year at the discretion of the Appointing Authority.
  • Executives/Executive Trainees must serve a minimum of 36 months after joining; a retention deduction of ₹5,000 per month will be made from salary, refundable (without interest) on completion of 36 months' service.
  • A service bond of ₹1.8 lakh must be executed to serve the company for a minimum of 36 months.
  • Appointment is subject to the candidate being declared medically fit by a Government Medical Officer/CMO of a Government Hospital, covering parameters such as vision, hearing, cardiovascular health, and more.
  • Category certificates must be valid as of the crucial date (01.08.2026); UPSC ESE 2024 category status does not automatically apply to MECL's process.
  • Candidates working in Central/State Government, PSUs, autonomous bodies, or nationalized banks must apply through proper channel or furnish a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of document verification.
  • MECL reserves the right to increase, decrease, or not fill any of the advertised vacancies, or to cancel, restrict, enlarge, modify, or withdraw the recruitment process at any stage, without prior notice.
  • Corrigenda or amendments will be published only on the MECL website (www.mecl.co.in) under the Career section; no further press advertisement will be issued.
  • Candidates should not register more than once for the same post; if multiple applications are submitted, only the one with the higher Application Number will be considered.
  • For technical queries related to the MECL Recruitment Portal, candidates may email [email protected] with screenshots of the issue.

The gross and CTC are approximate and include allowances; they differ between Metro (Bangalore) and Non-Metro postings. Candidates placed above the minimum would earn more than the quoted gross. Contract tenure is not stated on the position pages; the posts are described only as fixed-term contract.

Last date to submit the Google form 21 October 2026

How to Apply for HLL Lifecare Recruitment 2026

  1. Open the post's page on the HLL careers site and click the Google form link ("Click here to Apply").
  2. Download the prescribed job application form from the link in the Google form or from the HLL website (the careers page lists it as "Blank Application Format").
  3. Fill the form digitally and save it as PDF or Word. Handwritten forms are not accepted. Write the job title and reference code (for example, HLL/HR/092/2026) clearly on the form.
  4. Upload the completed form in the Google form's file-upload field; maximum 10 MB per file.
  5. Attach supporting documents in PDF or Word, each under 10 MB: CV, educational and experience certificates, and your latest salary slip.
  6. Select the correct post in the form's "post applied for" field so the application is routed properly.
  7. Submit on or before 21 October 2026. Late submissions are not considered.

Before you apply

  • Applications not in the prescribed format are rejected without any further communication, so use HLL's form, not a CV alone.
  • Check the post's experience rule for your qualification level; most posts require more years from graduates than from postgraduates.
  • If you work in a Government body or PSU, arrange the NOC now; it is required at the interview.
  • Everything stated in the form is verified against originals at the interview; a mismatch cancels the candidature at any stage.
  • Canvassing in any form disqualifies.

Selection Process

The position pages describe only an interview, at which original documents are verified and NOCs collected. No written test, shortlisting ratio or interview date is given. HLL reserves the right to cancel, restrict or modify the process, to leave posts unfilled, and to change the number of vacancies. The Management's decision on selection is final.

Naval Dockyard Mumbai Apprentice Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility depends on the trade applied for. Age, educational qualification and other norms are determined as on the crucial date, which is the closing date for online registration. Candidature is accepted only provisionally, and all claims are verified at the document verification stage. If any claim is found unsubstantiated at any stage, the candidature will be cancelled and the decision of Naval Dockyard Mumbai will be final.

Naval Dockyard Mumbai Apprentice Qualification

The minimum educational qualification follows Schedule I of the Apprenticeship Rules, 1992. ITI trades eligible for each designated trade are as per Schedule I, as amended from time to time.

Trade Minimum Qualification
Rigger Minimum 50% aggregate in 8th Standard (VIII Pass)
Crane Operator Overhead (SI) Minimum 50% aggregate in 10th Standard (X Pass)
All other designated trades Minimum 50% aggregate in relevant subjects in 10th Standard, followed by minimum 50% aggregate in ITI (consolidated, all semesters) in the respective trade under NCVT or SCVT

The notification says applications are invited from Non-ITI candidates (2 trades), ITI-qualified candidates (30 trades) and freshers. Candidates who have passed ITI can apply in their respective trades or corresponding NCVT-approved trades as per Schedule I. For example, an NCVT Turner or Tool and Die Maker certificate holder can apply for the Machinist trade. Candidates should check the matching NCVT trade before applying, and will be cancelled if they apply for a trade not relevant to their ITI trade.

Naval Dockyard Mumbai Apprentice Age Limit

As per the Apprentices Act, 1961, there is no upper age limit for apprenticeship training. Only a minimum age applies, counted on the crucial date (the closing date for receipt of online applications).

Category of Trades Minimum Age Trades
Non-Hazardous 14 years Advance Mechanic (Instruments), COPA, Electrician, Electronics Mechanic, Programming and Systems Administration Assistant, I&CTSM, Instrument Mechanic, Machinist, Marine Engine Fitter, Fitter, Mechanic (Central AC Plant, Industrial Cooling & Package Air Conditioning), Mechanic (Embedded System & PIC), Mechanic (Motor Vehicle), Mechanic Diesel, Mechanic Industrial Electronics, Mechanic Mechatronics, Mechanic MTM, Mechanic Ref & AC, Operator Advance Machine Tool, Pipe Fitter, Mason, Sheet Metal Worker, Shipwright Steel, Shipwright Wood, Crane Operator Overhead (SI), Rigger
Hazardous 18 years Foundryman, Pattern Maker, Tig / Mig Welder, Welder (G&E), Welder (Pipe and Pressure Vessels), Painter (G)

Date of birth is taken from the Class X certificate issued by the concerned Education Board. If the date of birth is not mentioned there, the birth certificate issued by the Competent Authority is used. For the Rigger trade, if the candidate does not have a Class X certificate, the birth certificate issued by the Competent Authority is used.

Note in the notification: an upper age limit is set in employment rules for the post of Tradesman Skilled in Naval Dockyards. It will apply to all ex-Naval Apprentices of Dockyard Apprentice School, Mumbai applying for that post after completing apprenticeship training.

Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

Naval Dockyard Mumbai Apprentice Application Fee

The application fee is not specified in the provided notification. The notification cautions candidates to beware of touts and job racketeers and states that no money is required to be paid to anyone for selection, which is based purely on merit.
